purpose: Own the application lifecycle and compose top-level game modules and authored scenes.
state_owner: Mission staircase, pickup placement, and exit condition
Game/editor ambient preview, application-wide local-light permission and independent sunlight enable setting
Local interface preferences and native menu navigation
Occlusion visualization mode, transient silhouette copies and structural material overrides
Temporary blast screen blur, oscillating ghost images and glitch envelope
Versioned local keyboard/mouse bindings and read-only runtime diagnostics
One-time shader warm-up quads at mission start
Scene-local mission/menu music and explicitly transferred application-owned completion playback, crossfades and derived combat intensity
Persistent planner-only fog-of-war preview preference; gameplay rendering stays enabled and reveal state remains owned by office_floor zones
Per-platform campaign config: level list and mode for each export build

runtime_contracts.level_chain_v1: user://level_chain.json {version:1, maps:[{name, entries:[{type none|ceiling|floor, x, z, placed} x2]}]}; map order is the chain, slot 0 leads to the previous map, slot 1 to the next. Map files and layout DTO unchanged.
runtime_contracts.planned_physics_v1: DTO v8 optional settled_physics={version:1}; transform-scoped sleep state. Corpse decor_pose.physics_v1 validated before replacement. Legacy v1-v8 compatible, ADR0055.
runtime_contracts.baked_floor_biomass_v1: Map v8 optional floor_biomass_v1={version:1,y,pages:[{x,z,png}],source_signature}; generated on Save Map/Layout, validated before replacement, restored as immutable pages; source records preserved. ADR0064.
runtime_contracts.quests_v1: Map v8 optional quests_v1=[{type find|kill|destroy|pickup|message|lesson, lesson, trigger{kind previous|time|steps|reach,value,target,point}, targets[object_id], complete{kind reach|destroy|collect|steps,value}, delay, text}]; normalized on load, played in list order by quest_runner, object ids from planning_object_id.
